column1: # BRENT TEST REGISTRY — the SINGLE machine-readable home for every registered test: its LEVEL and its INSTRUMENT.
# CONSUMED BY (do not restate these rows anywhere else):
#   scripts/thresholds.py        — grades level rows (direction/level/classification populated)
#   scripts/instrument_check.py  — probes every row's instrument for existence/reachability/freshness/window
#   thesis/THESIS.md             — carries PROSE + a POINTER here. It must NOT carry a second live table.
# ⚑ window_req VOCABULARY — 'same_session_action[:BASIS]'. BASIS names WHICH MOMENT makes the
#   test knowable, which is what instrument_check's window feasibility (4) is measured from:
#     :final     needs the closing/final value or a session aggregate -> window = action close - LAST print
#     :any       EXISTENCE form, any qualifying print satisfies it    -> window = action close - FIRST print
#     :atHHMM    spec names a clock time to grade at, ONCE            -> window = action close - HHMM
#   A BARE 'same_session_action' IS READ AS :final. Deliberate and fail-safe — an undeclared row keeps
#   firing the conservative red. THE LOOSENING MUST BE DECLARED PER ROW, NEVER INFERRED, or a basis fix
#   would silently weaken the check on every row that predates it. Unknown basis -> WINDOW_BASIS_UNKNOWN,
#   never a guess. Grade time before the instrument's open -> WINDOW_GRADE_BEFORE_OPEN.
#   Rationale + falsification record -> ../RULINGS.md#reading-basis
# WHY THIS FILE EXISTS (consolidation 2026-08-04, Will-approved on RAV's ruling):
# A threshold's identity lived in THREE places — THESIS §KEY THRESHOLDS (canonical prose),
# thresholds.py's hardcoded MARKET_/FRED_THRESHOLDS (which its own docstring called "a RESTATEMENT,
# and a restatement rots"), and workbook/INSTRUMENTS.tsv. thresholds.py:81 carried a standing TODO
# naming this as "instance n=2 fleet-wide of the registry-restatement class". Two rows had ALREADY
# rotted into alerting in the WRONG DIRECTION (the retired v4 "<$85 weakening" / "<$75 break" framing)
# — a guard worse than no guard. This file collapses the three homes to one.
# ⚠️ MIGRATED PROGRAMMATICALLY, NOT BY HAND: 21 market + 10 FRED rows were read out of the live python
# objects and written here, so no level, direction or classification passed through a human transcription.
# ⚑⚑ RETIREMENT SWEEP 2026-08-21 (BRENT file audit, Will-directed "fix all of them"). 9 rows live -> retired. ZERO rows deleted, ZERO levels changed.
#   THREE CLASSES, and the class is on each row's notes field:
#     (a) TEST FOR A POSITION THAT DOES NOT EXIST — MKT-STNG-BELOW-71.5 (an EXIT TRIGGER, classification=risk) + MKT-STNG-ABOVE-100.
#         STNG ruled a PHANTOM 2026-08-04 off Will's broker export and struck from TRADE.md and root CLAUDE.md the same day; these rows survived 17 days
#         because the phantom was swept from the POSITION surfaces and nobody swept the TEST surfaces. [[finding_record_of_an_action_is_not_the_action]]
#     (b) PERMANENTLY-BREACHED DECORATION — MKT-VLO-ABOVE-160 (+115%), MKT-MPC-ABOVE-170 (+112%), MKT-XOP-ABOVE-150 (+25%), MKT-LNG-ABOVE-255 (+8.9%).
#         Identical to the F4 condition Will ruled on 2026-07-31 for the 'gasoline crack >$30' line: a permanently-breached tripwire is decoration.
#         That ruling killed ONE instance; these four siblings survived it. Retiring an instance is not retiring the CLASS.
#     (c) UNREACHABLE BY CONSTRUCTION — MKT-USO-BELOW-80, MKT-USO-BELOW-75 (USO $134.50, lines ~40-44% below spot), MKT-XLE-ABOVE-100 (+57% away). Set in a different price regime.
#   ✅ FALSIFIED, NOT ASSERTED: re-ran thresholds.py before and after. The board did NOT go quieter in the way that would signal lost coverage — it went CLEARER.
#      With the four permanent greens gone, FRED-DCOILBRENTEU-ABOVE-100 now renders in NEAR THRESHOLDS at $95.29 (-4.7%): Dated Brent within 5% of the $100 line,
#      a live and meaningful row that had been sitting under four rows incapable of changing state.
#   ⚖️ GOVERNING LESSONS — stated per lessons_check --spec, because silence about whether a spec honours or overrides a lesson IS the failure mode:

#     L21 HONOURED (load-bearing): 'a threshold fails on its SPEC before it fails on the world.' Every row retired here failed on spec — unreachable, un-unfireable, or scoped to a non-existent position — not on being wrong about oil.
#     L22 HONOURED: a registration must name an instrument that TRADES and a threshold that can be CROSSED. (a) fails the first test, (b) and (c) fail the second.
#     L21/L22 HONOURED ON THE REPLACEMENT SIDE, and this is the constraint on anyone reading this later: NONE of these was RE-LEVELLED. Re-levelling without base rates

#       is the un-base-rated threshold L21/L22 forbid, and doing it under audit-day time pressure would be worse. A replacement refiner-margin / E&P / USO-drawdown line is a NEW REGISTRATION with base rates and a pre-registered boundary.

#     L16 HONOURED, and it is why (a) is a retirement rather than a re-level: 'equity stocks LEAD physical rates.' STNG remains a legitimate TRACKED TICKER inside the TANKER-LIVENESS composite max(|STNG|,|FRO|,|DHT|), which is UNAFFECTED and stays live. Tracking != owning.
#     L25 HONOURED, and it is the reason BRT-26-RIGS's probe changed on 2026-08-21: 'a source that HANGS is not a source that is DOWN.' That row's probe read
#       `manual:two independent aggregator pulls` — a field that had QUIETLY PROMOTED A CAVEAT INTO A SPECIFICATION. The caveat ('the BH primary times out, I have never
#       reached it') was false: the host tarpits a self-identifying User-Agent (TimeoutError at 20s AND 45s) and answers a browser UA in 0.1-0.4s. The probe is now the
#       PRIMARY workbook and the grade is taken from a LABELLED field. ⛔ NO LEVEL MOVED — 457 is untouched; this was an INSTRUMENT repair, which L21/L22 require and L25 explains.
#       ⚠️ Generalisation deliberately WITHHELD: thresholds.py keeps an identifying UA against FRED and is verified working, so it was NOT changed — a green instrument is not
#       edited on an untested inference. 6 of 6 OTHER BH static files still genuinely 403; this ONE file is open, and that distinction is the whole finding.
#     L23 HONOURED, and the registry's position is now stated instead of implied: the MKT-BZ-F-* / MKT-CL-F-* rows key on CONTINUOUS =F symbols. L23 says a =F ticker silently re-points at the roll,
#       which makes it UNSAFE FOR A DELTA and FINE FOR A LEVEL. Every =F row here is a LEVEL test (direction+level, graded per-print), so L23 is honoured, NOT overridden.
#       ⛔ DO NOT compute a spread, curve or WoW change from these rows — STATUS deliberately quotes NAMED contracts (BZV26/X26/Z26) for exactly that reason, and the two bases must not be mixed.

#     L05/L06/L08/L09/L10/L11/L15/L19 flagged by the sweep as NOT CITED: they govern the registry's CONTENT (what to measure and how prices/latency behave), not this retirement DECISION. Untouched by it; no position taken here.
# COLUMNS
#   test_id        stable ID. Cited by cards/packets — treat as an API, do not renumber.
#   kind           threshold | gate | falsifier | prediction
#   status         live | retired   (RETIRED ROWS STAY. They are the do-not-resurrect list.)
#   source         yf | fred | (blank for non-price tests)
#   symbol         ticker or FRED series id
#   direction      above | below   (blank = instrument-only row, no level to grade)
#   level          numeric trigger (blank = instrument-only)
#   classification risk | thesis | stress
#   probe          yf:<T> | fred:<S> | http:<URL> | chain:<T>@<EXPIRY> | manual:<what> | none
#   window_req     daily | weekly | event | same_session_action
#   co_instrument  for same_session_action: the market the ACTION happens in
#   max_stale_days staleness budget; -1 = n/a
#   supersedes     what this row replaced, or "none". REQUIRED on new rows (see CLAUDE.md).
# ⚠️ ADD A ROW IN THE SAME EDIT that registers a test. An unregistered test is invisible to both
#    consumers — the state that produced every defect this registry was built after.

BASIS DECLARED: this row grades ICE BRENT FRONT-MONTH FUTURES. BZ=F is the continuous front-month and ROLLS CONTRACTS UNDERNEATH THIS LEVEL. ROLL RULE OF RECORD: BZ=F tracks the ICE front month and steps to the next contract at that contract's roll; the step is a BASIS CHANGE, NEVER a market move, and must never be read as a threshold approach or breach. MEASURED ROLL LEDGER (Sep-26 -> Oct-26): 2026-07-29 BZ=F 90.74 vs BZV26 88.09 = 2.65 gap; 2026-07-31 90.12 vs 87.93 = 2.19; 2026-08-03 83.77 vs 83.77 = 0.00 ROLLED. => the registered instrument stepped ~$2.2 from the ROLL ALONE with no price move = 2.6% of the 85 line. GRADING DISCIPLINE: any breach or un-breach printed within 2 sessions of a roll must be re-read against the NAMED CONTRACT (BZV26/BZX26/...) before it is written down as a market event. PROBE DELIBERATELY LEFT ON BZ=F: pinning to a named contract would go dead at every roll and hand the row a NO_INSTRUMENT red four times a year; the fix Will ruled permits is 'record roll adjustments on the row', which this is. NO LEVEL MOVED BY THIS EDIT.
